Class OrderExecutionService

java.lang.Object
app.order.execution.OrderExecutionService
@Service public class OrderExecutionService extends Object
Turns a PENDING order that passed the rule pipeline into a fill, atomically, and moves it to FILLED (KAN-93). This class does not itself decide whether a trade is allowed, it carries out one that already was.

Simplification: this fills at the order's client-submitted indicativePrice rather than a live market quote — business-backend doesn't yet read the quotes/market_ticks tables FMS writes. BR-08 calls for the quote price prevailing at execution time, and KAN-100's buffer_percent tolerance only means something once there's a live price to compare the indicative price against. Wiring that up is follow-on work (plausibly KAN-129) — fillPrice below is the one line to change once a quote source exists; everything downstream of it (ledger writes, balance/holding updates) doesn't need to change.

Funds: cash belongs to the user, not to an account, so a BUY debits and a SELL credits the owning user's availableFunds (KAN-93). accounts.cash_balance is not moved. A cash_transactions row is still written for every fill so the movement is on the ledger.

Funds and holdings were already checked once by the pipeline, against a snapshot that can go stale between validation and execution. This class re-checks both under a row lock immediately before writing the fill, so two concurrent orders can't both spend the same balance or the same holding. An order that fails that re-check is REJECTED.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      @Transactional public Order execute(Order order, Instrument instrument)
      Executes an order whose trading rules have passed.

      A fill records a FILLED audit event naming the fill price and its source (FILL_PRICE_SOURCE), the signed cash change for the owning user, and the signed holding change for the account. Change FILL_PRICE_SOURCE together with fillPrice once a live quote source exists.

      Parameters:
      order - the PENDING order to execute
      instrument - the instrument being traded
      Returns:
      the order as FILLED, or REJECTED if funds or holdings were no longer sufficient under the row lock
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the account or its owning user no longer exists
